messages.content: Hi there! Thanks for taking the time to chat with me today. To start, could you tell me about the high-level goals for modernising the mobile banking app? What are you hoping to achieve?

Hey! Thanks for having me. So, honestly, I just want an app that feels modern and quick, like Revolut. It’s frustrating using my bank’s app because it feels outdated. I just want to be able to see what’s happening with my money in real-time, you know? Like, I want to know immediately when money leaves my account. Also, if I lose my card, I should be able to freeze it right away without having to talk to anyone. Just simple stuff like that.

That makes sense! So, you're looking for a modern and quick app that provides real-time updates and features like instant card freezing. Could you share more about what other specific features or tools you think would be important for this app?

Sure! I mean, it would be great to get some sort of monthly spending breakdown. Just like a summary of where my money goes—categories like groceries or dining would be helpful. And being able to set a budget for each category and get alerts when I’m close to going over would be awesome too. 

Oh, and it would be nice to have everything on one screen—like my current account, savings, and credit card all visible at once. That's what I like about Revolut. It makes it so easy to see everything.

Got it! So, you're looking for a monthly spending breakdown with categories, budget-setting features, alerts for spending limits, and a consolidated view of all your accounts on one screen. That sounds really useful! 

Are there any limitations or restrictions we should keep in mind while developing these features?

I haven't really thought about limitations or restrictions. I'm just focused on what I want to see in the app. I guess it would be helpful if everything works smoothly together, but I'm not sure what that involves. I just want it to feel easy and not complicated, like it sometimes is with my current bank app.

That’s understandable! You want a smooth and easy-to-use experience without complications. So, if I understand correctly, you’re looking for features like real-time spending notifications, instant card freezing, a monthly spending breakdown, budget-setting with alerts, and a consolidated view of all accounts on one screen. 

Could you give me an example of a fintech app feature that you find really helpful and would like to see in the bank's app?

Yeah, definitely! I really like how Revolut sends me notifications right away when I spend something—like, I get a push notification with the amount and where I spent it almost instantly. It keeps me on top of everything. I just want that kind of immediate feedback in my bank's app too. It makes managing my money feel a lot easier.

That’s a great example! So, you want immediate push notifications for transactions, similar to what Revolut offers, to help you manage your money better. 

Just to recap, you’re looking for features that include real-time spending notifications, instant card freezing, a monthly spending breakdown, budget-setting with alerts, and a consolidated view of all accounts on one screen. 

One last question: Are there any specific security features or compliance measures that you think are important for the app?

Honestly, I haven’t really thought about specific security features. I just want to feel safe using the app, like knowing my data is protected and that I can log in easily without too much hassle. I guess some sort of fingerprint or face recognition would be nice for logging in quickly. But I'm not really up on all the technical details or compliance stuff. I just want it to work well and keep my information secure.

Thanks for sharing that! So, you're looking for the app to have easy login options, like fingerprint or face recognition, to enhance security while ensuring your data is protected. 

To summarize the requirements we’ve gathered: you want real-time spending notifications, instant card freezing, a monthly spending breakdown, budget-setting with alerts, a consolidated view of all accounts on one screen, and secure login options like fingerprint or face recognition.
